<document id=DOC_req_years_eight>
Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_no_dates>
Backend engineering across transactional services, most recently a
settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day. Previously worked on
payment reconciliation and inventory systems.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary below to match the posting requirement.

If years of experience are neither stated nor calculable, ask me for the
figure and tell me what it costs not to supply it.

response.text:
The provided candidate summary does not state or allow calculation of the candidate's years of experience. 

Could you please provide the total number of years of backend engineering experience the candidate possesses?

**What it costs not to supply this figure:**
Without a specific number of years, the candidate cannot be explicitly matched against the mandatory 8-year requirement. Omitting it risks immediate disqualification by applicant tracking systems (ATS) and human screeners who filter strictly on hard minimum requirements, regardless of the quality of the candidate's technical achievements.
